_note: Migrated verbatim from the curated lists the app already ships, so every
value an existing profile holds still matches. Nothing here is invented:
`religions` is ProfileOptions.religions in its original order, and each
religion's `communities` is its entry in ProfileOptions._communitiesByReligion.
Codes are derived from the label the same deterministic way city codes are
(uppercase, accents stripped, punctuation collapsed), so HINDU-VELLALAR is
reproducible from 'Hindu' + 'Vellalar' and never needs to be looked up.
Inter-Religion carries the UNION of every community rather than an empty
list. That is not a guess: ProfileOptions.communitiesFor() falls back to the
full union for any religion absent from the map, so this is exactly what the
app shows today for Inter-Religion. Preserving it keeps the dropdown from
Sub-caste is deliberately absent. No caste -> sub-caste relationship exists
anywhere in the project (ProfileOptions.subCommunities is a flat list with no
parent), and inventing one is not an option - see profile_basics_page.dart.
That field stays free text until a sourced dataset is supplied.
